rationale: OWNER DIRECTIVE 2026-09-02 (designblog.co.uk critique session): 'please go ahead with the planner prompt and exemplar changes.' The estate has planned ONE infographic ever and 25 illustrations across 5 sites, against hero 399 / icon 211 / logo 50 (fleet census 2026-09-02, inline_guide_imagery lane) — and the cause is measured, not guessed: the live build-site-planner plan_site prompt ALREADY carries the full kind vocabulary (logo|hero|illustration|icon|infographic), and four surfaces in the same prompt suppress content imagery, so the near-zero is the planner OBEYING. The four surfaces, verified verbatim against the live row 2026-09-02: (1) the sections bullet instructs 'Use sparingly in v1 — most plans will have zero section-scope entries'; (2) rule 13's stated minimum is chrome-only (logo + heroes); (3) the worked example's sections block demonstrates ONLY icons, no infographic anywhere; (4) the Return-JSON skeleton demonstrates "sections": {}. Exemplars govern (the estate's recorded a-quoted-exemplar-in-a-prompt-is-copied-verbatim trap; the copy lane's proven demonstrations-govern mechanism). Migration 718 flips all four in one anchored change: the bullet now states content-carrying imagery is expected, WITH two limits that answer the known traps — attach only to sections whose component can display it (SITE_DEFECT_CATEGORIES 4.1, generated-and-undisplayable; the editorial_design_uplift lane's same-day 69-minute rollback is the cautionary precedent) and only where there is something real to depict; rule 13 gains a floor of one section-scope illustration-or-infographic under the index page and explicitly EXEMPTS empty-sections pages (rule 3) because article pages have no structure to host imagery (bugs_open/114) — in-article imagery is deliberately NOT forced by this change; the worked example gains an index:1 illustration and a tools:1 infographic, both written text-free with headings-in-HTML (image models render garbage lettering); the skeleton demonstrates one entry. Rule 16 (one image per entry) is deliberately untouched and asserted present in the verify block — raising section-scope volume without it produces the multi-panel collage failure it exists to prevent. Downstream readiness: IMG-075 per-section binding is live (2026-09-02 15:39 roll); illustration/infographic pass the DB CHECK per rule 15. Cost (more generated images per build, every future build including the 18 queued remakes) was stated to the owner and he ruled go. Mechanics: five anchors each asserted exactly-once with length-delta, template-variable and {{if}}/{{else}}/{{end}} balance guards (LANDMINES: two lanes edit this agent; anchored replace, never wholesale jsonb_set); snapshot_agent before update; DO/RAISE verify; companion ROLLBACK whose roundtrip was proven byte-exact against the live text; full guard chain dry-run against the live row in a rolled-back transaction before submission (all pass, verify NOTICE fired).

plan.risks: Blast radius is every subsequent new-site build (incl. the 18 queued remakes). Checks a reviewer should make: (1) rule 16 survives verbatim — without it, higher section-scope volume produces multi-panel collages; (2) the rule-3 exemption is real — forcing section imagery onto blog-post/guide pages whose sections arrays are empty would attach entries to sections that do not exist; (3) the display-capability limit in the new bullet is instruction-only — nothing mechanical stops a planner attaching an illustration to a plain prose section, so the residual risk is SITE_DEFECT_CATEGORIES 4.1 (generated-and-undisplayable) at a higher base rate, mitigated but not closed; (4) generation cost rises with section-scope entry count — the owner accepted this, but a runaway plan (many entries per section) is bounded only by the model's judgement plus rule 16's decomposition discipline; (5) two other lanes edit this row — the anchors were asserted exactly-once against the live text at 2026-09-02 ~20:30Z and the migration refuses loudly on drift rather than splicing wrong.
